newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks close at record high.
newsitem.headline: French stocks close at record high.

text.p: French shares rose sharply and established a fresh closing high on Wednesday but ended below an all-time intra-day high reached earlier in the day.
Brokers said a firmer dollar and gains on Wall Street on Tuesday and Wednesday were supporting the market as was a fresh record high in Germany.

The CAC-40 index closed at 3,069.30, up 1.51 percent, smashing the previous record closing high of 3,025.94 set on Friday July 25. The new all-time intra-day high is 3,075.93, outclassing Monday's 3,044.24.
Volume was a hefty 10.4 billion francs of which eight billion francs was in CAC-40 blue-chip shares.
The July share future, which expires on Thursday, added 13.50 points to 3,076.
The biggest riser was Ciments Francais, up 13.80 percent at 240 francs after its forecast for significantly higher second half results.
Tyre group Michelin, down 3.36 percent at 385.90 francs, was the biggest loser. Dealers said this was related to the first half results of Japanese rival Bridgestone.
Sanofi, up 6.23 percent at 648, was the second-biggest traded share on speculation it may abandon the perfumes business and concentrate on health products.
Alcatel-Alsthom, up 3.26 percent at 791, was biggest volume stock.
